name: Ricardo Alves
bio:
Ricardo Alves's passion for motorsport ignited during his childhood spent watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued a degree in mechanical engineering, determined to blend his technical aptitude with his love for racing. After graduating, he started as a junior engineer at a small Brazilian racing team, quickly climbing the ranks due to his sharp analytical skills and ability to identify critical areas for improvement.

His pragmatic approach to team management emphasizes data-driven decision-making and efficient resource allocation. He believes in fostering a collaborative environment where every team member feels empowered to contribute their best. While technically astute, Ricardo understands that success also relies on strong interpersonal skills and a clear vision for the future. He's known for his calm demeanor even under intense pressure, enabling him to make rational choices in high-stakes situations.

Ricardo is particularly interested in exploring advanced simulation technologies to optimize car setups and driver performance. He is eager to take on new challenges and aims to lead a team to championship glory by combining technical expertise with strategic foresight.
